parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is the lens of the camera, made primarily of optical glass with a metallic housing.
parts.Functional_description: The lens focuses light onto the image sensor to capture photos or videos. It may include zoom and focus mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It can extend or retract during zooming or focusing operations, controlled by internal motors.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the shutter or power button of the camera, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to power the camera on/off or to capture images when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the camera, made of aluminum alloy for strength and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components including the sensor, battery, and circuitry, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the rigid frame for the entire device.
